```diff
+  * FLOATING RECTANGLE WIDGET - Main App
+  * ============================================================================
+  * 
+  * Features:
+  * - 3D translucent plastic rectangle background
+  * - Text paste input area
+  * - Explanation panel in different color
+  * - Suggestion options
+  * 
+  * ============================================================================
+  */
+ 
+ import React, { useState, useRef } from 'react';
+ import { Canvas } from '@react-three/fiber';
+ import * as THREE from 'three';
+ import FloatingRectangle from './FloatingRectangle';
+ 
+ // ============================================================================
+ // STYLES
+ // ============================================================================
+ const styles = {
+   container: {
+     width: '100vw',
+     height: '100vh',
+     background: 'transparent',
+     position: 'relative',
+     fontFamily: '-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "Segoe UI", sans-serif',
+   },
+   canvas: {
+     position: 'absolute',
+     top: 0,
+     left: 0,
+     width: '100%',
+     height: '100%',
+     zIndex: 0,
+   },
+   ui: {
+     position: 'absolute',
+     top: 0,
+     left: 0,
+     width: '100%',
+     height: '100%',
+     zIndex: 10,
+     display: 'flex',
+     flexDirection: 'column',
+     padding: '20px',
+     pointerEvents: 'none',
+   },
+   header: {
+     display: 'flex',
+     justifyContent: 'space-between',
+     alignItems: 'center',
+     marginBottom: '12px',
+     pointerEvents: 'auto',
+     WebkitAppRegion: 'drag',
+   },
+   title: {
+     fontSize: '14px',
+     fontWeight: '600',
+     color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)',
+     textShadow: '0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)',
+   },
+   closeBtn: {
+     width: '24px',
+     height: '24px',
+     borderRadius: '50%',
+     background: 'rgba(255, 100, 100, 0.8)',
+     border: 'none',
+     cursor: 'pointer',
+     display: 'flex',
+     alignItems: 'center',
+     justifyContent: 'center',
+     fontSize: '12px',
+     color: 'white',
+     WebkitAppRegion: 'no-drag',
+   },
+   inputArea: {
+     flex: '1',
+     display: 'flex',
+     flexDirection: 'column',
+     gap: '12px',
+     pointerEvents: 'auto',
+   },
+   textInput: {
+     flex: '1',
+     minHeight: '120px',
+     padding: '14px',
+     borderRadius: '12px',
+     border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)',
+     background: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)',
+     backdropFilter: 'blur(10px)',
+     color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95)',
+     fontSize: '13px',
+     fontFamily: '"SF Mono", "Fira Code", monospace',
+     resize: 'none',
+     outline: 'none',
+     lineHeight: '1.5',
+   },
+   explanationPanel: {
+     padding: '14px',
+     borderRadius: '12px',
+     background: 'rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2)',
+     border: '1px solid rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3)',
+     backdropFilter: 'blur(10px)',
+     minHeight: '100px',
+   },
+   explanationTitle: {
+     fontSize: '11px',
+     fontWeight: '600',
+     color: 'rgba(147, 197, 253, 0.9)',
+     marginBottom: '8px',
+     textTransform: 'uppercase',
+     letterSpacing: '0.5px',
+   },
+   explanationText: {
+     fontSize: '13px',
+     color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85)',
+     lineHeight: '1.6',
+   },
+   suggestions: {
+     display: 'flex',
+     gap: '8px',
+     flexWrap: 'wrap',
+     marginTop: '12px',
+   },
+   suggestionBtn: {
+     padding: '8px 14px',
+     borderRadius: '8px',
+     border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
+     background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
+     color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)',
+     fontSize: '12px',
+     cursor: 'pointer',
+     transition: 'all 0.2s ease',
+     backdropFilter: 'blur(5px)',
+   },
+   footer: {
+     marginTop: '12px',
+     display: 'flex',
+     gap: '8px',
+     pointerEvents: 'auto',
+   },
+   actionBtn: {
+     flex: 1,
+     padding: '10px 16px',
+     borderRadius: '10px',
+     border: 'none',
+     background: 'rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.6)',
+     color: 'white',
+     fontSize: '13px',
+     fontWeight: '500',
+     cursor: 'pointer',
+     transition: 'all 0.2s ease',
+   },
+ };
+ 
+ // ============================================================================
+ // MAIN APP COMPONENT
+ // ============================================================================
+ function App() {
+   const [inputText, setInputText] = useState('');
+   const [explanation, setExplanation] = useState('Paste terminal output or any text above to get an explanation of what it means.');
+   const textareaRef = useRef(null);
+ 
+   const handlePaste = async () =&gt; {
+     try {
+       const text = await navigator.clipboard.readText();
+       setInputText(text);
+       analyzeText(text);
+     } catch (err) {
+       console.error('Failed to read clipboard:', err);
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const analyzeText = (text) =&gt; {
+     if (!text.trim()) {
+       setExplanation('Paste terminal output or any text above to get an explanation.');
+       return;
+     }
+ 
+     // Simple analysis - in production this would call an AI API
+     let analysis = '';
+     
+     if (text.includes('error') || text.includes('Error') || text.includes('ERROR')) {
+       analysis = '⚠️ This appears to be an error message. Check the specific error details above for the root cause.';
+     } else if (text.includes('npm') || text.includes('yarn') || text.includes('node_modules')) {
+       analysis = '📦 This looks like Node.js/npm output. It may be showing package installation or script execution results.';
+     } else if (text.includes('git') || text.includes('commit') || text.includes('branch')) {
+       analysis = '🔀 This appears to be Git output. It shows repository status or version control operations.';
+     } else if (text.includes('$') || text.includes('%') || text.includes('&gt;&gt;&gt;')) {
+       analysis = '💻 This looks like terminal/shell output. The symbols indicate command prompts.';
+     } else if (text.includes('success') || text.includes('Success') || text.includes('✓')) {
+       analysis = '✅ This indicates a successful operation completed without errors.';
+     } else {
+       analysis = '📝 Text received. This appears to be general output. Paste more specific terminal output for detailed analysis.';
+     }
+ 
+     setExplanation(analysis);
+   };
+ 
+   const handleTextChange = (e) =&gt; {
+     const text = e.target.value;
+     setInputText(text);
+     analyzeText(text);
+   };
+ 
+   const suggestions = [
+     { label: '📋 Paste', action: handlePaste },
+     { label: '🗑️ Clear', action: () =&gt; { setInputText(''); setExplanation('Paste terminal output or any text above to get an explanation.'); }},
+     { label: '📄 Copy', action: () =&gt; navigator.clipboard.writeText(explanation) },
+   ];
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div style={styles.container}&gt;
+       {/* 3D Background */}
+       &lt;Canvas
+         camera={{ position: [0, 0, 6], fov: 50 }}
+         gl={{
+           alpha: true,
+           antialias: true,
+           toneMapping: THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping,
+           toneMappingExposure: 1.2,
+         }}
+         style={styles.canvas}
+         onCreated={({ gl }) =&gt; {
+           gl.setClearColor(0x000000, 0);
+         }}
+       &gt;
+         &lt;FloatingRectangle width={4.2} height={5.2} depth={0.15} radius={0.25} /&gt;
+       &lt;/Canvas&gt;
+ 
+       {/* UI Overlay */}
+       &lt;div style={styles.ui}&gt;
+         {/* Header */}
+         &lt;div style={styles.header}&gt;
+           &lt;span style={styles.title}&gt;📋 Terminal Explainer&lt;/span&gt;
+           &lt;button 
+             style={styles.closeBtn}
+             onClick={() =&gt; window.close()}
+           &gt;
+             ×
+           &lt;/button&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+         {/* Input Area */}
+         &lt;div style={styles.inputArea}&gt;
+           &lt;textarea
+             ref={textareaRef}
+             style={styles.textInput}
+             placeholder="Paste terminal output here or type anything..."
+             value={inputText}
+             onChange={handleTextChange}
+             spellCheck={false}
+           /&gt;
+ 
+           {/* Explanation Panel */}
+           &lt;div style={styles.explanationPanel}&gt;
+             &lt;div style={styles.explanationTitle}&gt;💡 Explanation&lt;/div&gt;
+             &lt;div style={styles.explanationText}&gt;{explanation}&lt;/div&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+           {/* Suggestions */}
+           &lt;div style={styles.suggestions}&gt;
+             {suggestions.map((s, i) =&gt; (
+               &lt;button
+                 key={i}
+                 style={styles.suggestionBtn}
+                 onClick={s.action}
+                 onMouseEnter={(e) =&gt; {
+                   e.target.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)';
+                 }}
+                 onMouseLeave={(e) =&gt; {
+                   e.target.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)';
+                 }}
+               &gt;
+                 {s.label}
+               &lt;/button&gt;
+             ))}
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+         {/* Footer Actions */}
+         &lt;div style={styles.footer}&gt;
+           &lt;button 
+             style={styles.actionBtn}
+             onClick={handlePaste}
+             onMouseEnter={(e) =&gt; e.target.style.background = 'rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.8)'}
+             onMouseLeave={(e) =&gt; e.target.style.background = 'rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.6)'}
+           &gt;
+             📋 Paste from Clipboard
+           &lt;/button&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   );
+ }
+ 
+ export default App;
+ 
```

</details>

</tool-use>
